note: Time Zone (tzfield) defines a field type 'tzfield' storing a tz-database identifier (e.g. Europe/London) in an indexed value varchar(50) column; default_widget=tzfield_default, default_formatter=basic_string. Widgets: tzfield_default (region-grouped select) and tzfield_offset (sorted by current UTC offset). Formatters: core basic_string (raw id, default) and tzfield_date (formatted current date, setting 'format', default T). Per-field settings (field.field_settings.tzfield): exclude (list), default_site (bool), default_user (bool). Allowed values come from DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers() (implements OptionsProviderInterface). No configure route, permission, or Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real field config: introspection reads the field's widget and excluded zone; execution creates a tzfield field, or switches a tzfield field's widget to tzfield_offset, verified against the live field/form-display config.

evals.prompt: I want to store a time zone like Europe/London on a content type in Drupal using the tzfield module. What field type do I add, and what value does it store?
evals.expected_output: Add a 'Time zone' field (field type id tzfield). It stores a single tz-database identifier string (e.g. Europe/London) in an indexed varchar(50) value column; allowed values come from DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers().

evals.prompt: Which form widgets does the tzfield module provide for a Time zone field, and how do they differ?
evals.expected_output: tzfield_default ('Time zone') is a select grouped by region; tzfield_offset ('Time zone with current offset') is a select sorted by and labelled with each zone's current UTC offset, e.g. (UTC+01:00) Europe/London.

evals.prompt: How can a tzfield Time zone field display the current local time or time-zone abbreviation instead of the raw identifier, and what controls the output?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'Formatted current date' formatter (tzfield_date) instead of the default basic_string. It renders the current time in the stored zone using its 'format' setting, a PHP date format string (default 'T', e.g. GMT/EST).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Time zone field called field_tz_known. Inspect the live default form display and state which tzfield widget it uses.
evals.expected_output: tzfield_offset ('Time zone with current offset') — the component type for field_tz_known in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Time zone field field_tz_known on Article has one time zone excluded from its allowed options via its field settings. Inspect the live field configuration and name the excluded time zone.
On this Drupal site, using the tzfield module, add a Time zone field with machine name field_tz_new to the Article content type. Apply the change to the live site so the field exists on Article.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig node.field_tz_new of type 'tzfield' plus a FieldConfig on node.article.field_tz_new (e.g. FieldStorageConfig::create(['field_name'=>'field_tz_new','entity_type'=>'node','type'=>'tzfield'])->save(); then the FieldConfig on the article bundle).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Time zone field field_tz_widget currently using the default 'Time zone' widget. Change its widget on the default form display to the tzfield 'Time zone with current offset' widget (tzfield_offset). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_tz_widget component has type: tzfield_offset (e.g. $fd->setComponent('field_tz_widget', ['type'=>'tzfield_offset', ...])->save()).
